name: Abyssal Fissure
text: You stamp on the ground, which crumbles beneath your feet. All creatures touching the ground in a 60-foot long, 15-foot wide Line originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 3d12 Fire damage, 3d12 Necrotic damage, and falls 15 feet if not otherwise held aloft. On a success, a creature moves up to its Speed so that it is no longer in the area of the spell, if a creature is unable to move outside the area of the spell, it fails the saving throw. When the spell ends, the fissure closes. All creatures within the fissure must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to the Abyss. On a successful save, a creature is shunted to their nearest unoccupied space. If you are not touching the ground when you cast this spell, it has no effect. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage Fire and Necrotic damage both increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Aldarth’s Abbey
material: a transcribed prayer and a ruby worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes
text:
You conjure an abbey, shimmering into existence on the ground you can see within range. The abbey must fit within an unoccupied cube of space, up to 150 feet in any dimension. The abbey remains until the spell ends. You make all decisions about the abbey’s appearance. Only you and creatures of your choice can enter the abbey. Sensors created by Divination spells can’t appear inside the abbey, and creatures within can’t be targeted by Divination spells. While a creature is within the abbey, it gains the following benefits:

Calmed. It has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened conditions.

Devoted. It has Advantage on Intelligence (Religion) checks.

Revitalised. Whenever it rolls dice to regain Hit Points, it

regains additional Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. Rested. Whenever it finishes a Long Rest, it gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.

name: Alicorn Spear
text: You conjure a spear, tipped with a unicorn’s horn, and magically hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 2d10 Piercing damage, and 2d10 Radiant damage, and glows for the duration. A glowing creature sheds Dim Light in a 15foot radius, and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition. At the end of each of its turns, the glowing target makes a Constitution saving throw, ceasing to glow on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Piercing damage or the Radiant damage increase by 1d10 for each slot level above 2.

name: Ascend
text: You float upwards, magically pulled through to the other side of the surface directly above you. After surfacing, you can choose to immediately return all affected creatures to their original positions. If there is not a flat surface at most 30 feet directly above you, or the other side of the surface isn’t flat, this spell fails. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can bring one additional creature that is making contact with you for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Baneful Weapon
text: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon. Whenever a creature is hit with this weapon, that creature must subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saving throws it makes for 1 round. Additionally, attacks with this weapon deal an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage.

name: Beckon Beasts
material: a bone carved with depictions of animals, worth 300+ GP
text:
You call forth six phantasmal beasts. They each manifest in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and use the Phantasmal Beast stat block. A creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creatures share a turn in combat. They can each attack individually, or multiple can group together against a target within their shared reach, increasing the chance to hit, and the damage of an attack. For example, if you have three beasts remaining, you may choose to make two attacks, one attack with one beast against a target within its reach, and one attack against another target within the reach of your two remaining beasts. The creatures are allies to you and your allies. In combat they share your Initiative count, but take their turn immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, they take the Dodge action and use their movement to avoid danger. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can summon one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

Phantasmal Beast Small Beast, Neutral AC 10 + the spell’s level Hit Points 5 Speed 30 ft. Savig Throws 1 + the spell’s level to all saves Immunities All Conditions CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits Limited Activity. The beast cannot take any Bonus Actions, Reactions, or actions other than those specified in its statblock, or the Dash, Disengage, and Dodge actions. Phantasmal Nature. If the beast takes damage from an attack roll or failed saving throw, it dissipates and dies. If the spirit takes damage from another source (such as from a successful saving throw), it dissipates and dies if the damage it would take equals or exceeds its Hit Points, otherwise it takes no damage.

Actions Bite. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier + the amount of summons that make the attack, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d4 for each beast that makes the attack Force damage.

name: Beeblebrox
text: You magically grow a second head granting you Advantage on saving throws against the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions, and on Wisdom (Perception) checks. You can use an Action to end the spell early.

name: Bestow Sunlight Sensitivity
text: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, on a failed save, while in sunlight, the target has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Blackbolt
text: You fire a concentrated beam of darkness towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 2d10 Psychic damage, and has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Blade Beam
text: Make a Melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against a creature within range. On a hit, you deal the normal damage for the attack + 1d10 Radiant damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The additional Radiant damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Blade Dance
material: ten metal rings each worth 1+ CP, worn on each finger
text: You cause a weapon within range to float in your space, moving at your whims. To control the weapon, you must have hands free as if you were wielding it, and you count as wielding it for the duration. Whenever you attack with the floating weapon, you can use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. A creature within 5 feet of you can attempt to grab the weapon from the air as an Action, making a Strength saving throw. On a successful save, the creature grabs the weapon and the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you use a level 3 or 4 spell slot, the duration is 1 hour, if you use a level 5+ spell slot, the duration is 8 hours.

name: Blessed Weapon
text: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon. While wielding this weapon, a creature adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Additionally, attacks with this weapon deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage.

name: Chromatic Armor
material: a scale from a chromatic dragon worth 50+ GP
text: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target’s base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier, and can’t be reduced. Additionally, choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. The target has Resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends, or until it uses a Bonus Action to choose a different damage type to gain Resistance to.

name: Cleansing Blaze
text: A creature within range is engulfed in flames called down from the heavens. The target makes a Constitution Saving Throw, taking 10d6 Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, at the start of each of its turns while it doesn’t have the Unconscious condition, the target regains 2d6 Hit Points. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

name: Coinshot
text: You fire the coin used in the casting of this spell at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes Bludgeoning damage equal to 5d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, the coin becomes embedded in the target, until a creature takes the Utilize action to remove it, or another effect causes it to be removed. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Commune with Collector
text: You contact a collector, an enigmatic entity that hoards items from throughout the multiverse. You may ask up to three questions before the spell ends. In response to your questions, three non-magical items from the collector’s vault will appear in front of you, each item answering a question as best as possible, and appearing in the order you asked your questions. These items disappear in a puff of smoke after 1 minute. Collectors aren’t omniscient, and in the case the answer to a question lies beyond the collector’s knowledge, you may receive a sheet of parchment with a black cross marked on it. If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

name: Damnation
material: a vial of blood from a Fiend worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes
text: You point at a creature within range that isn’t a Fiend, pouring out the vial of blood and causing it to be hurled through the lower planes. The target disappears and makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 6d12 Fire damage and 6d12 Necrotic damage, and it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and instantly returns to the space it previously occupied.

name: Deathsight
text:
For the duration, you perceive a faint colored aura surrounding creatures you can see. The colour of the aura indicates the relative health of the creature

Green. The creature has all its Hit Points. Yellow. The creature’s current Hit Points are lower than its Hit Point maximum.

Orange. The creature is Bloodied. Red. The creature’s current Hit Points are equal to or less than a tenth of its Hit Point maximum.

Gray. The creature has 0 Hit Points and is Unconscious. Black. The creature has 0 Hit Points and is Dead.

name: Defibrillating Smite
text: The target hit by the attack roll takes an extra 2d12 Lightning damage from the attack. If the target is a creature and this damage doesn’t kill them, they then regain 2d4 Hit Points. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Dim
text:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn’t being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object emits shadows causing the area within a 30-foot radius of it to become Lightly Obscured. The shadows can be colored as you like Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the shadows. The spell ends if you cast it again. Light Interaction

If an area of shadows from the Dim cantrip and an area of light from the Light cantrip overlap, both cantrips are dispelled.

name: Drakeblood
material: a vial of dragon’s blood, worth 70+ GP
text:
You infuse yourself with the blood of a Dragon, granting you the following benefits:

Fear. When you cast this spell, each creature of your

choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition. Resistance. Choose one of the following damage types, you have Resistance to it: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Breath Weapon. When you cast this spell, you can eject magical energy from your mouth in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 damage of the same type this spell grants you Resistance to on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You can repeat this effect by taking the Magic action as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns. Wings. Wings sprout from your back, giving you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Optional Bonus Rule

If you harvest blood of a dragon that is not Chromatic or Metallic, you can use it as the material component for the Drakeblood spell, and use the damage type of its Breath Weapon (choose one if it deals multiple) for the Resistance option of this feature.

name: Earsplitting Snap
text: You click your fingers towards a creature or object in range, creating a deafening cracking noise. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Thunder damage and you have the Deafened condition until the start of your next turn. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach level 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Electrify Atmosphere
text: Lightning strikes all creatures of your choice within a 30foot Emanation of you. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 damage, and can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Enhance Gravity
text: You intensify gravity in a 15-foot-radius, 50-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Flying creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they fall to the ground beneath them. Creatures within the area have Disadvantage on saving throws against the Prone condition, and creatures that are Prone must use all their Speed to right themselves and end the condition. Additionally, the area is considered Difficult Terrain for any creatures that are flying or have taken the Dash action

name: Ethereal Mark
text: You mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Additionally, you can see the target, even if it has the Invisible condition or is on the ethereal plane, and can affect it as if it were on the material plane. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you use a spell slot of level 5+ , you can maintain your Concentration on the spell for up to 24 hours.

name: Explosive Boulder
text: You create a boulder of rock and lava and fire it at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, the boulder then explodes. The target and each creature within 15 feet of it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

name: Eyeblast
text: You shoot a bolt of light at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 2d8 Radiant damage and it cannot see further than 30 feet from itself except with blindsight, tremorsense, or truesight until the end of its next turn. A creature that is immune to the Blinded condition is immune to this effect. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: False Appearance
text: You and everything you’re wearing transform into an exact duplicate of a Tiny object you can see within 5 feet of you. While in this form, you have the Blinded, Incapacitated, and Restrained conditions, however you are able to maintain Concentration on this spell, and you gain Blindsight to a range of 30 feet.

name: Flashbolt
text: You shoot a bolt of radiance at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Radiant damage and has Disadvantage on Perception checks until the end of its next turn unless it is Immune to the Blinded condition. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach level 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Flurry Rush
text: You make two attacks with Melee weapons or Unarmed Strikes against the creature that missed you. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can make one additional attack for each spell slot level above 2

name: Focused Assault
text: Roll the damage dice for the effect twice, and choose one of the two totals. The effect deals the chosen amount of damage.

name: Freezing Blade
text: You coat your weapon or fists with frost, then make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The attack can use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Cold damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice), and the target suffers the effects of the Slow mastery property. Cantrip Upgrade. Whether you deal Cold damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals 1d8 extra Cold damage when you reach level 11.

name: Freezing Smite
text: The target hit by the attack roll takes an extra 2d8 Cold damage from the attack, and it must make a Constitution saving throw or its Speed is halved and it cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Glue Ground
text: Inspiration: Stormlight - Adhesion Choose three unoccupied spaces on a surface within range, they begin to glow with a Dim Light. Whenever a creature touches a glowing space they become stuck to it, their Speed becomes 0 and can’t increase. As an action, a stuck creature can make a Strength saving throw. On a successful save that space ceases glowing. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of spaces you can select increases by one for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Godblood
material: a vial of blood from a Celestial creature
text:
You infuse yourself with divine ichor, granting you the following benefits:

Vigor. You gain 100 Temporary Hit Points. If you lose all

Temporary Hit Points, the spell ends, additionally you lose all Temporary Hit Points when the spell ends. Resistance. You are Resistant to Radiant damage and Necrotic damage. Strength. Whenever you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make an additional attack, and you have Advantage on all attacks with a Melee weapon, and with Unarmed Strikes. Warding. You have a +2 bonus to AC. Radiant. Whenever you hit a creature with a Weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you can expend up to 10 Temporary Hit Points, dealing an extra 1d10 Radiant damage for every 5 Temporary Hit Points Expended.
higherLevel:
You gain 15 Additional

Temporary Hit Points for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Ground of Cognition
text: A translucent pink film coats the ground in a 30-foot Emanation centered on you. If you or an ally deal Psychic damage while touching this ground, they deal additional Psychic damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, while touching this ground, the first attack made against you and each of your allies each round has Disadvantage.

name: Ground of Conduction
text: A crackle of lightning surges, coating the ground in a 30foot Emanation centered on you. When an enemy touching this ground takes Lightning damage, they take additional Lightning damage equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, while touching this ground you and your allies are Immune to the Unconscious condition while they have more than 0 Hit Points.

name: Ground of Growth
text:
Grass shoots up from the ground in a 30-foot Emanation centered on you. If you or an ally start your turn touching this ground they gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, while touching this ground, you and your allies have Advantage on saving throws to avoid the Prone condition. Optional Bonus Rule

The ground affected by this spell cannot be affected by the Earthquake spell.

name: Ground of Mist
text:
A pink mist imbued with protective energies covers the ground in a 30-foot Emanation centered on you. While you or an ally are touching this ground they have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned conditions. Optional Bonus Rule

If you or an ally are touching this ground, they have Advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons.

name: Guiding Mark
text: You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 2d8 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Additionally, you can make attack rolls against the target even if you cannot see it, and it cannot benefit from Half or Three-Quarters Cover against your attacks. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you use a spell slot of level 5+, you can maintain your Concentration on the spell for up to 24 hours.

name: Hammerspace
text: You cause an object that you’re holding to disappear into a pocket dimension. For the duration, you can take the Magic action as a Bonus Action, summoning the item to a hand you have free, or returning it to the pocket dimension. When this spell ends, the item returns to a hand you have free, or to a free space within 5 feet of you. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you use a Level 3+ spell slot you can instead cause an object you are wearing to disappear. Additionally, the duration increases with a spell slot of level 3 or 4 (8 hours), 5 or 6 (7 days), 7 or 8 (30 days), or 9 (Indefinite).

name: Heighten Emotions
text: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature): If the creature has or gains the Frightened condition, its speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased until the condition or spell ends. If the creature has or gains the Charmed condition, it has disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws and cannot speak a deliberate lie until the condition or spell ends. The creature becomes Hostile or Friendly (your choice) about creatures of your choice that it’s indifferent towards. Hostility ends if the target damages the creature, and friendliness ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature’s attitude returns to normal.

name: Hellfire
text: Hellfire coats your hand before springing to a creature you touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 Fire damage and 1d6 Necrotic damage Cantrip Upgrade. The damage (both Necrotic and Fire) increases by 1d6 when you reach level 5 (2d6 each), 11 (3d6 each), and 17 (4d6 each).

name: Horrific Maw
material: a tooth from a Large or larger creature
text: Your jaw unhinges, stretching far further than should be possible. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the creature is swallowed, shunted to a demiplane within you. While within this demiplane, at the start of each of its turns, it takes 12d4 Acid damage. The creature can still target you with attacks and spells, and you have Resistance to all damage it deals. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Incorporeality
text: For the duration, you can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. Additionally, any Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take is reduced by 4. If you end your turn inside a creature or object, you take 1d10 Force damage, and if the spell ends when you are inside a creature or object, you take 8d10 Force damage, and are shunted into the nearest unoccupied space. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage reduction increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Infect
text: The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 Poison damage and have Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach level 5(2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Ionize
text: You charge a creature within range with electricity. The next time that creature deals Lightning damage, they deal extra Lightning damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier, and the spell ends. All creatures that take this damage cannot use their Reaction until the start of their next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Lesser Step
text: You teleport to a point you can see within range, returning to your original position after you take an action.

name: Lorem Ipsum
text: You touch a piece of blank paper or parchment, causing words to appear upon it. For the duration, at a glance, the words appear to be a document of your choice (such as a spell scroll, identification, newspaper, or legal document). This spell does not hold up to scrutiny, any creature that takes time to read it is aware of the forgery.

name: Maturing Meristem
material: a piece of bark, carved into a circle
text: The ground in a 5-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within range is coated in bark. Each creature touching this bark must make a Strength saving throw to avoid being coated in bark themselves. A Plant creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw. On a failed save, for the duration a target has Paralyzed condition, has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and takes an additional 1d6 damage whenever it takes Fire damage. Additionally, a Paralyzed creature is magically aged a year at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, a Paralyzed creature repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

name: Mental Blast
text: You create a psionic burst of pain centered on a point within range. Each creature of your choice in a 10-footradius Sphere centered on that point makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 5d8 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If you use this spell while touching ground within a Ground of Cognition spell, area increases to a 20-footradius sphere, and the damage increases by 1d8 Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Modify Friction
text:
You lessen or heighten the effects of friction on a creature within range. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

Lessen. For every 5 feet the creature moves in a direction, it slides an extra 10 feet. A creature that is flying is Immune to this effect. Heighten. The ground counts as Difficult Terrain for the creature.
higherLevel:
You can target one

additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Old Wounds
text: Using your magics, you are able to pull open wounds a creature had previously sustained. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it becomes susceptible to a damage type of your choice that the attack deals. Whenever the target takes damage of the chosen type, it takes an additional 2d6 damage. This affects the damage dealt by the triggering attack. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Open Wound
text: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, it takes 1d6 Necrotic damage. Additionally, if you hit that creature with this cantrip on your next turn, you deal an extra 1d6 damage. Cantrip Upgrade. The initial and bonus damage increase by 1d6 at level 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Osseous Ring
text: You summon a circle of five bones which float in a 5-foot Emanation around you for the duration. When the Emanation enters a creature’s space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can attempt to hit it with one of the bones (no action required). Make a melee spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the creature takes 1d10 Slashing damage, and 2d6 Necrotic damage. Hit or miss, a bone is destroyed, and a creature can be attacked in this way only once per turn. Additionally, as a Bonus Action you can cause one of the bones to fly at a creature within 120 feet of you. Make a Ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage and 2d6 Necrotic damage. Hit or miss, the bone is destroyed. The spell ends when you have no bones remaining. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of bones you summon increases by two for each spell slot level above 5, additionally, if you cast this spell using a level 7+ spell slot, the Emanation increases to 10 feet.

name: Paint Bomb
text: You create three balls of paint, launching them and causing them to explode in spaces within range. Each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere of one of these points makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 4d4 Bludgeoning damage and 3d4 Acid damage, and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. Additionally, the ground within these spheres is covered in a thin layer of wet paint. This wet paint counts as Difficult Terrain for all creatures except you and your allies. If an area of wet paint comes into contact with water it washes away, otherwise, the paint dries after 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Bludgeoning damage and Acid damage increase by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3. Additionally, you can create another ball of paint for every 2 spell slot levels above 3.

name: Paired Portals
material: a piece of amber and a sapphire
text: You create two portals, each of which hover in an unoccupied space within range for the duration. At the start of each of your turns, you can force a creature within 5 feet of a portal to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of the other portal. As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can cause each portal to move up to 30 feet.

name: Petal Step
text: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range, reappearing in a storm of petals. Each creature within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If you use this spell while touching ground within a Ground of Growth spell, the range increases to 120 feet, and creatures have Disadvantage on the Dexterity saving throw. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Placeholder
text: You touch the floor of a room no larger than 20 feet in any dimension. The room is decorated via illusions in a fashion of your choosing for the duration. The illusory decorations can be interacted with as if they were solid objects, however the entire illusion is dispelled if they would be used to cause any damage. To discern that decorations are illusory, a creature must take the Study action to inspect them and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The maximum area of the room increases by 10 feet in every dimension for each slot level above 2. If you use a level 4-5 spell slot the duration is 24 hours. If you use a level 6-7 spell slot, the duration is 7 days. If you use a level 8+ spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.

name: Polluting Blade
text: You coat your weapon or your fists with a black sludge, then make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The attack can use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Poison damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice), and the target suffers the effects of the Sap mastery property. Cantrip Upgrade. Whether you deal Poison damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals 1d8 extra Poison damage when you reach level 11.

name: Protective Portaling
text: You briefly open a portal directly in front of you, the creature moving towards you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure the creature is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

name: Quickstop
text: The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. This spell fails if the target has taken a turn since you rolled Initiative.

name: Raedon’s Water Bubble
text: A bubble of water surrounds you, granting you resistance to Fire damage, a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and the ability to breathe underwater. If you take Cold damage, the spell ends, and you have the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn. If you would take damage, you can use your Reaction to gain Immunity to the triggering damage, afterwards the spell ends. This effect fails if any damage you would be dealt is Cold or Psychic damage.

name: Raedon’s Water Weapon
text: Water coats the weapon you’re holding. The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the target takes 2d6 Cold damage, and is pushed back 5 feet for every 5 or 6 rolled on the damage dice. After this the spell ends. If you are in contact with water when casting this spell, the damage increases by 1d6. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Raedon’s Watery Blast
text: You create an arc of water, firing it towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Cold damage, and is pushed back 5 feet for every 5 or 6 rolled on the damage dice. If you are in contact with water when casting this spell, the damage increases by 1d6. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Reorientation
text: You alter gravity for yourself, adjusting which way is down for you. You can pick any direction (as if under the effects of gravity). If you collide with something you take falling damage as normal. You can take the Magic action as a Bonus Action on later turns to change this direction.

name: Revealing Blade
text: Your weapon or your fists begin to glow with a warm light. Make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The attack can use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Radiant damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice), and you gain the benefits of the Vex mastery property. Cantrip Upgrade. Whether you deal Radiant damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals 1d8 extra Radiant damage when you reach level 11.

name: Scorched Earth
material: a jar of alchemist’s fire worth 50+ GP
text: Flames erupt from the ground in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. All creatures touching this ground must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 10d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Plant creatures have Disadvantage on this save. Additionally, whenever a creature enters this area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it takes 2d6 Fire damage.

name: Seer’s Mark
text: You magically mark a creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 3d6 Psychic damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack. Additionally, while you and the target are on the same plane of existence, you know exactly how far away from you it is, and in what direction. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

name: Sigil of Closeness
text: You touch a willing creature, placing a divine mark on their body. For the duration, you can cast any spells with a range other than Self on this creature regardless of distance. You can maintain Concentration on this spell and a spell affecting the marked creature, making a single Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration on both when you take damage. When the spell ends, any spells you have cast on the marked creature are dispelled. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If you use a spell slot of level level 5+, you can cast spells with a range of Self on the marked creature.

name: Sky Sprinter
text: For the duration you can move horizontally across the air with your movement. You only fall if you are not on a solid surface at the end of your turn.

name: Snakebite
material: a leather glove you’re wearing worth 1+ SP
text: Your glove transforms into the body and head of a snake, striking out. Make a Melee spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Grappled condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). While the creature has the Grappled condition, it also has the Poisoned condition, and takes 1d8 Poison damage at the end of each of its turns. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The initial damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Snapping Skull
text: You summon a phantasmal skull, which flies towards a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack, on a hit, the target takes 4d8 Necrotic damage and the skull latches onto it. While the skull is latched onto a creature, at the end of each of its turns it takes 1d6 Piercing damage. The skull can be removed with the Utilize action, or is destroyed when the target takes at least 5 damage in a single turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the damage required to destroy the skull increases by 3, for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Soul Sanctuary
material: a vial of poison, which the spell consumes, and a container worth 800+ GP
text:
You ingest the poison used in this spell’s casting, and invest your soul into the container used in the spell’s casting, which becomes your Soul Sanctuary. Your Soul Sanctuary has 50 Hit Points, and an AC of 15. While your Soul Sanctuary holds your soul, you gain the following effects.

Living Death. Your Creature Type becomes Undead. One Foot In The Grave. You cannot restore Hit Points

through any magical means, such as spells or potions.

One Foot Out. It takes five failed Death Saving Throws to kill you.

Eternal Soul. When you die, if you are on the same plane of

existence as your Soul Sanctuary, your body disintegrates. The next dawn, you are restored to life in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your Soul Sanctuary with 1 Hit Point, and an Exhaustion level of 5.

name: Spectral Scythe
text:
You create a floating spectral scythe in a space of your choice that lasts for the duration. When you summon it and as a Bonus Action on each of your following turns, you can move the scythe up to 20 feet and use one of the following effects:

Harvest. A creature of your choice within 5 feet of the

scythe gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus your Spellcasting ability modifier Reap. Make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the scythe. On a hit, the creature takes 3d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier in Force damage. If you hit a creature that is Seeded you can choose to deal an extra 2d4 Force damage to the creature and regain Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt. If you do, the creature is no longer seeded. Sow. A creature within 10 feet of the scythe becomes Seeded. A Seeded creature takes 2d4 Force damage at the start of its turn. If you use this option and a creature is already Seeded, they are no longer seeded.
higherLevel: The number of dice you roll for each option increases by one for every 2 spell slot levels above 5.

name: Spin Attack
text: Make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike against each creature within 5 feet of you.

name: Splatter Shot
text: The bucket used in the casting of this spell ejects a forceful spray of paint. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 4d4 Bludgeoning damage and 3d4 Acid damage and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. Additionally, the ground within this Cone is covered in a thin layer of wet paint. This wet paint counts as Difficult Terrain for all creatures except you and your allies. If an area of wet paint comes into contact with water it washes away, otherwise, the paint dries after 10 minutes. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat this effect, the spell ends early if you drop the bucket. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Bludgeoning damage and Acid damage increase by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Splatter Slide
text: You charge forward, leaving a trail of paint in your wake. Move up to your Speed in a straight line, when you pass within 5 feet of a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d4 Bludgeoning damage and 1d4 Acid damage and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save it takes half as much damage only. This movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks. Additionally, the ground you cross is covered in a thin layer of wet paint. This wet paint counts as Difficult Terrain for all creatures except you and your allies. If an area of wet paint comes into contact with water it washes away, otherwise, the paint dries after 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Bludgeoning damage and the Acid damage increase by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 1, you choose.

name: State of Flux
text:
Through steeping yourself in the chaotic whims of history, you learn how to briefly channel the wild nature of time itself. When you enter this state, and at the start of each of your subsequent turns while in this state, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice:

Luck. You receive brief flashes of the future, steeling

yourself against oncoming assaults. Whenever you make a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, you can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to the total. Resistance. You rewind time, knitting together injuries as they occur. You have resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. Swiftness. Time stutters, slowing others but hurtling you forward. Your Speed increases by 15 feet, and you do not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The benefit lasts until the start of your next turn. You cannot choose the same benefit two rounds in a row.

name: Summon Ancient
material: a small humanoid statue worth 300+ GP
text: You call forth the spirit of a bygone Humanoid, returning them to life as a statue. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Ancient Statue Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Healer, Sage, or Warrior. Your choice determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

name: Summon Arcane Automaton
text: You call forth the spirit of an arcane automaton. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Arcane Automaton Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose two weapons from the following list: Cannon, Flamethrower, Frost Emitter, Shock Emitter, Water Emitter, and Wrecking Ball. Additionally, choose one upgrade from the following list: Barding, Fan, Outlook, and Rocket. Your choices determine certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

name: Summon Avatar
text: You summon an avatar of your god, which appears as a Celestial or Fiend of CR 10 or lower, in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The avatar disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The avatar is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. It shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you), as long as they don’t violate its tenets. If you don’t issue any commands to the avatar, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions. The DM has the creature’s statistics. Due to the nature of this spell, it may be helpful for you to decide with your DM what creature the avatar will appear as when you prepare this spell. At the DMs discretion, the Avatar may appear as a creature other than a Celestial or Fiend.

name: Summon Boom Stick
text:
You cause a Boom Stick, a small plant that shoots its seeds like a crossbow, to sprout forth from the ground. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the Boom Stick stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

Boom Stick Small Plant, Neutral AC 10 + the spell’s level Hit Points 15 + 10 for each spell level above 1 Speed 0 ft. MOD SAVE

Immunities Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned Senses Darkvision 60ft., Passive Perception 10 Languages Understands the languages you know CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits Planted. The spirit’s Speed cannot increase.

Actions Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell’s level (rounded down). Seed Shooter. Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 60 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell’s level Bludgeoning damage.

name: Suppressing Smite
text:
The target hit by the attack roll takes an extra 3d8 Force damage from the attack, and if it is Concentrating on a spell, it has Disadvantage on the Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration that this damage causes. Additionally, the target must make a Constitution saving throw or it cannot take the Magic action for the duration.

Ancient Statue Spirit Medium Construct, Neutral AC 11 + the spell’s level + 2 (Warrior only) Hit Points 40 + 15 for each spell level above 3 Speed 30 ft. MOD SAVE

Immunities Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned Senses Darkvision 60ft., Passive Perception 12 Languages Common, Understands the languages you know CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits Ancient Fortitude. If damage reduces the spirit to 0 Hit Points, unless the damage is from a Critical Hit, it can make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken. On a success, the Spirit drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Sage’s Counsel (Sage Only). While within 15 feet of the companion, you and your allies gain a bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom checks equal to half this spell’s level (rounded down).

Actions Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell’s level (rounded down). Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell’s level Bludgeoning damage.

Bonus Actions Healer’s Light (Healer Only). The spirit shines light on a creature it can see within 15 feet of itself. The creature gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 + the spell’s level.

Reactions Warrior’s Protection (Warrior Only). When a creature within 5 feet of the spirit makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, the spirit imposes itself between the creature and the danger. The creature can add half this spell’s level (rounded down) to the saving throw.

name: Taunting Blade
text: Your weapon or your fists become coated in a translucent, pink film. Make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The attack can use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Psychic damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice), and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn. Cantrip Upgrade. Whether you deal Psychic damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals 1d8 extra Psychic damage when you reach level 11.

name: Telekinetic Eruption
text: Each creature within a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d10 Force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A protective shield radiates in a 5-foot Emanation of you, anything within the shield is Immune to the effect. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Terrain Blast
text: You shoot a bolt of malleable force at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Force damage. If you use this spell while touching ground within the area affected by a spell with the Terrain tag, you instead deal 1d12 damage of the terrain’s associated damage type. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by one die when you reach level 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

name: Terrain Flare
text: You cause energy to flare up around a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Force damage. If the target is touching ground within the area affected by a spell with the Terrain tag, you instead deal 1d12 damage of the terrain’s associated damage type. Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by one die when you reach level 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

name: Terrify
text: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it has the Frightened condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Transmute Liquid
text: You touch the bottle used in the casting of this spell. If the bottle is filled with fresh water, salt water, common wine, or beer, you can transmute it into one of the other liquids listed. Cantrip Upgrade. The list expands to include more liquids at level 5 (tea, rum, and oil), 11 (coffee, fine wine, and basic poison), and 17 (acid, and truth serum).

name: Twist of Fate
material: a drop of blood and sprinkling of holy water
text: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d6. If the number is odd, they subtract the number from the roll, if it’s even they add the number to the roll. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Ventriloquism
material: some parchment rolled into a cone
text: A single creature of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure any words you speak for the duration will come out of the creature’s mouth in the creature’s own voice in place of your own. Furthermore, for the duration the creature can’t speak other than your words.

name: Wall of Darkness
text:
An inky wall of darkness appears at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose: horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. It can be free floating, or it can rest on a solid surface. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight, but creatures and objects can pass through it. It emits shadows, lightly obscuring the area within 150 feet of it. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 Necrotic damage, and has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A Frightened creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While a creature is Frightened in this way, its Speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased. A creature must make this saving throw when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Arcane Automaton Spirit Large Construct, Neutral AC 12 + the spell’s level + 2 (Barding only) Hit Points 40 + 15 for each spell level above 5 Speed 30 ft. MOD SAVE

Immunities Psychic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned Senses Darkvision 60ft., Passive Perception 13 Languages Understands the languages you know CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

Traits Crow’s Nest (Outlook Only). The spirit can act as a mount for up to two creatures at once. Mounted Design. The spirit’s Initiative doesn’t change to match that of creatures that mount it, however it can take actions other than Dash, Disengage, and Dodge.

Actions Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell’s level (rounded down). Cannon Fire (Cannon Only). Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 600 ft. Hit: 2d6 + the spell’s level Bludgeoning damage. Flame Bolt (Flamethrower Only). Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 30 ft. Hit: 3d6 + the spell’s level Fire damage. Freezing Strike (Frost Emitter Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell’s level Cold damage, and the target’s Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Shocking Strike (Shock Emitter Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell’s level Lightning damage, and the target can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Slam (Wrecking Ball Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2d6 + 3 + the spell’s level Bludgeoning damage. This attack is a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. Water Pulse (Water Emitter Only). Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 15 ft. Hit: 2d6 + the spell’s level Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed back 5 feet for every 5 or 6 rolled on the damage dice. Shield. The spirit and any creatures mounting it have ThreeQuarters Cover.

Bonus Actions Boost Forward (Fan Only). The spirit moves up to half its Speed. Burst of Speed (Rocket Only, 1/Day). The spirit moves up to twice its Speed.

name: Wall of Paint
text: A wall of paint bursts from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 4d4 Bludgeoning damage and 4d4 Acid damage, has the Prone condition, and can’t benefit from the Invisible condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. The ground within 10 feet of the wall is covered in a thin layer of wet paint. This wet paint counts as Difficult Terrain for all creatures except you and your allies. If an area of wet paint comes into contact with water it washes away, otherwise, the paint dries after 10 minutes. A creature moving through the wall for the first time on a turn makes a Strength saving throw, taking 4d4 Bludgeoning and 4d4 Acid damage and gaining the Prone condition on a failed save, or taking half as much damage only on a successful one. Additionally, it cannot benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of its next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Bludgeoning damage and Acid damage increase by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Wall of Radiance
text: A curtain of shimmering light descends within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is translucent and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature of your choice in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d8 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A non-allied creature that moves through the wall’s area takes 6d8 Radiant damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Wall of Wax
text: A nonmagical wall of semi-solid wax springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 5 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall. The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can’t occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn’t need to be vertical, though it must rest on a firm foundation. A creature can pass through the wall using 15 feet of movement. When a creature does so, they destroy the panel they move through and take 4d8 Fire damage. The wall is an object made of wax that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 8 and 10 Hit Points, and it has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Reducing a panel to 0 Hit Points or dealing any Fire damage to it destroys it. When a panel is destroyed, it may cause connected panels to collapse at the DM’s discretion. If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for its full duration, the wall solidifies, becoming permanent and unable to be walked through or dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage the wall deals increases by 1d8, and the number of Hit Points the wall has increases by 5, for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Wave Dash
text: You charge forward, performing a series of hops that cause water to erupt from the ground. Move up to your Speed in a straight line, when you pass within 5 feet of a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d6 Cold damage, and is pushed back 5 feet for every 5 or 6 rolled on the damage dice, on a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. This movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks If you are in contact with water when a creature makes this save, the damage increases by 1d6. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: William’s Wall of Wood
text: A nonmagical wooden blockade springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 2 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall. The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can’t occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn’t need to be vertical but must rest on a firm foundation. The wall is an object made of wood that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 10, 10 Hit Points per inch of thickness, and is Vulnerable to Slashing and Fire damage. Reducing a panel to 0 Hit Points destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM’s discretion. If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for its whole duration, the wall becomes permanent and can’t be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.

name: Withering Blade
text: Your weapon or your fists become shrouded in cold darkness. Make an attack with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The attack can use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Necrotic damage or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice), and the target suffers the effects of the Topple mastery property. Cantrip Upgrade. Whether you deal Necrotic damage or the weapon’s normal damage type, the attack deals 1d8 extra Necrotic damage when you reach level 11.
